title: Something happened to you online.
subtitle: Tell us what happened, in your own words. No account, no ID upload, no forms: just a calm way to get it reported.

trust.label: Nothing you submit is sold or shared

moneyCard.eyebrow: The one journey this prototype builds end-to-end
moneyCard.title: Money was taken from my account
moneyCard.body: Report it in under 90 seconds. We'll ask for the essentials only.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. No forms, no wait to find out what happens next.

steps.title: Tell us what happened
steps.body: Write it in your own words. There's no right way to say it, and no minimum length.

steps.title: Confirm the facts
steps.body: We pull out the amount, date and reference automatically. You check it and confirm.

steps.title: Filed instantly
steps.body: You get a Complaint ID the moment you submit: nothing to wait on, nothing to follow up for.

steps.title: Track anytime
steps.body: Come back with your Complaint ID whenever you want to see exactly where your case stands.

trustSection.title: Why this is safe to use right now

items.title: No login needed to start
items.body: Start typing immediately. Creating an account is optional, only if you want to come back and track later.

items.title: Report in under 90 seconds
items.body: One question at a time, in plain language. We only ask for what's actually needed.

items.title: Nothing you submit is sold or shared
items.body: Your report goes only to the process that handles it. Nothing more.
